# #912 — retire-collab-migration suite fails intermittently in the full isolated run once the admin URL is supplied (#904)

Filed by Claude (head, session 8, claudex opus) from the #910 lane report.

Once `bun run test:isolated` exports `OPENBRAIN_SCRATCH_ADMIN_URL` (#910, #904 step 1), `scripts/retire-collab-migration.test.ts` stops skipping and runs in the full suite. On the first pre-push run of that branch it failed twice: `beforeAll` timeout, then `Cannot use a pool after calling end on the pool` at `src/db/migrate.ts:45` via `runMigrations`. Alone it passes 12/0 on origin/main and on the branch with the var set; two later full runs were clean and the retried push passed. So it is intermittent under full-suite ordering, and #910 makes it reachable rather than causing it.

Owner side is undetermined: either the suite shares a pool that another file ends (bun's `mock.module` is global, see the #903 lane note on `scripts/__tests__/bulk-import.test.ts` mocking `src/db/pool.ts`), or `runMigrations` closes a pool it did not open. #904 step 3 (converting this file) reads `src/db/migrate.ts:45` and the suite's pool lifecycle first and names the side.

Done means: 20 consecutive full `bun run test:isolated` runs with no failure in this file, recorded on this issue, plus the ownership verdict with file:line.

## Discussion (1)

### rodaddy — 2026-08-27T08:09:57Z

Cause established on CI (run 33051884236, probe in #910): afterAll's DROP DATABASE of the 48-migration scratch db takes 23.7-30+s on the self-hosted runner's shared PostgreSQL 17 disk versus 744ms on the ephemeral pg18 container in db-integration; pool.end 1ms, attached sessions 0. Not a straggler session. Fix in #910: teardown allowance 120000ms with the measurement in a comment. The disk contention itself belongs with #915 (runner).
